blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Manila-based Asian Development Bank (ADB) and global debt watcher S&P Global Ratings sharply cut their growth forecasts for the Philippines this year, citing the fallout from the prolonged Middle East conflict, weak government spending and climate-related shocks.
